description:
• Who is Dean Turner Art? :  Imagine hanging out with 20-40 of your favourite celebrities - dead or alive!  It's not likely, but having them on your wall is!

Dean Turner paints unique 'Ultimate Reunion' scenarios with well known celebs from Country, Heavy Metal, Hip Hop, Rock, Pop, Movies and Sports. 

Deans original paintings take up to 12 months to design and paint on a 3m wide canvas.  Our shop then sells high quality framed prints from the originals RRP $597 (on Sale $400-$500).

We have over 9,500 facebook followers and our posts have 4k, 6k, 8k and 18k likes with thousands of comments and shares - People are BLOWN AWAY by the imagination and quality of Deans art.

The Ultimate Reunion Series currently contains 11 prints completed over the last 13 years.  Our business has refined the quality of the product, the packing, shipping and customer support excellent.

We are well stocked in Australian and the United States with around 700 available canvases in each country.  We are only selling in AU and USA at this stage.

Each artwork will require its own unique approach to marketing.  For example, the 'Ultimate Hip Hop Reunion' will be best targeted at Hip Hop influencers, Hip Hop social pages, Hop Hop radio station,  Physical Hip Hop clothing stores etc. Perhaps you could even get one of the featured artists to sign up under your MLM

The 'Ultimate Classic Country Reunion' will require a country themed focus.  Aside from country alternatives to the hip hop options, we suggest contacting pubs and clubs in country music areas - getting them to purchase the art for their pubs, and arranging a QR code attached to their own affiliate link.  Why would a pub feature this art?  As we've learned in Australia - pub customers absolutely love these paintings - they spark up great conversations about artists they've seen, they try and guess all the people in the painting and it raises the 'fun' of visiting this pub.

If you wanted to 'hit the road' - you could use your affiliate link to sell the art to physical businesses that could also become affiliates.

Meet the Dean Turner Art Team:
Dean - our incredible artist

Mary - Deans wife.  Orders container loads of stock, fulfils orders, handles shipping and customer enquiries, accounting and all other business operations.  

Scott - Website, Facebook Marketing, Social Media, Email Marketing and now - affiliate marketing

Dean, Mary & Scott work hard to make sure every customer has a great experience and when needed, sorts out any issues (like rogue couriers). 

We have a 100% customer satisfaction guarantee & a great review record to back it.  We guard our reputation and integrity fiercely!  We only want happy customers!

We currently sell approx. 60-100 canvases per month online, and the same at markets and festivals.  Our business operations are well established, and we'll grow at a manageable rate.  We will add the right affiliates at a pace we can manage.

• What makes us different: Most artists sell original works - not prints.  That means you can't really scale up sales.  Also, artists who paint celebrities tend to focus on one person or a band.  It's very limited.

Dean spends a year to make an INCREDIBLE painting with 20-40 well known celebrities, then sells hundreds of prints off them.  

People LOVE his art (Seriously - check our reviews and facebook post comments!)

For you, it means tapping into a world of passionate people who 'must have this art' with their fav celebs!  


How good is the pull to buy?  Strong - really strong - we see it every day.

ZZ Top saw our 'Highway to Hell' print and purchased 5 for themselves and their friends!'     

Lots of other stars have sighed and own Deans work including Alice Cooper, Mick Fleetwood, Blondie, Jimmy Barnes, Steve Vai, Jackson Browne and Steve Bauer.  They all love it.  But the majority of the world still doesn't know about Deans work.  That's where you come in!


• How affiliates can earn: We are new to affiliate marketing, but we want to support affiliate stars like you who see opportunity.  

We've set up an attractive Multi Level Marketing program to incentivise you to get to those high traffic networks that we just don't have time to get to... Influencers, Bands, Fan Pages, it's all wide open!  

If you have a favourite strategy that we have not yet set up - let us know so we can support you!


• How to promote us:  As long as you are not spamming the hell out of people or trying to scam anyone (including us), we'll back your ideas. 

We run a few facebook ads and do local markets and festivals, but online is largely untapped for us.  If you have ideas - talk to us - work with us!

• Other information:  Aside from online referrals, we see a massive opportunity for physical businesses to buy and become referrers.

Anyone who shows initiative and results for this focus - we'll back you 1000%.  Wether you are hitting the pavement, the phones or email - the opportunity here is massive!

Why Physical businesses?  Firstly, Deans art adds value to their business! 

Customers love standing around talking about their favourite stars.  It provides a real connection point & conversation opportunity between businesses and customers.  

We've had over 13 years of businesses buying more than one artwork without any referral program in place - just because it makes their business more popular with customers!

Now that we are offering a referral program, our existing business customers are getting really excited!  We suggest selling a busess one artwork, then printing a names list with a QR code with their referral link below it.  

Any time a customer scans the link, their referral program will be in play. With a 90 day cookie and more than one art option for end customers to choose from - there is a high potential for purchase.

Business owners could also add a mention to in their emails or on their website on how customers in store have been raving about the art - along with their affiliate link.

Here are some store examples to get you thinking:

Hip Hop clothing store - it would fit their culture and have customers ranting at how cool it was.  Plenty of happy vibes to create between staff and customers.

Country Music Pub - Customers would gather around picking out their favourites, sharing stories about meeting their hero's and concerts they've seen.  Those happy vibes do keep customers coming back!

Pizza Shop - (Ultimate Gangster Reunion).  While people are waiting for their pizza (or dining in), they'll be picking out the movies and stars that played key roles.  This is a really popular artwork for our mafia movie fans!

Record Store  - (so many art options!).  What could be more iconic than seeing 'Ultimate Eagles/Stones/Queen/Beatles Reunion' on the wall of a music store - or 'Highway to Hell' in a hard rock/Metal Music store.  And do you think they'd be interested in a referral program???

Boxing Gym/Any Gym - The 'Ultimate Boxing Reunion' features athletes that have worked hard in the gym, hit their goals and become a legacy.  They are not only fan favourites, but they are pictures of what can be achieved with hard work in a gym.  Staff that are knowledgeable on featured boxers can relay stories of hard work, challenges and successes - conversations that build connection with their customers.

A few other ideas are:
- Furnitures stores

- Music instrument stores

- recording studios

- hotel receptions/gyms

- radio stations

- Hair dressers

- Restaurants/Cafe's/Bars/Clubs/Pubs (our biggest opportunities)

- Sales based businesses looking for 'ice breaker' discussion opportunities

- Motor bike shops (Highway to Hell fits!)

- Mechanics

The opportunities are wide open.

If you like the idea of going door to door - we can discuss supplying a rolled canvas option.  It's better than carrying a whopping great framed canvas around town, and means you can give the client the full impact of the size before they buy.  

We are also planning on putting together some merchandising material just for 'door to door' sales people.

As we said - we are new to the affiliate game, so bear with us as we build our supporting marketing material, our program and our support processes for you - our affiliate partners.

Got ideas?  We'd love to hear them.

If you are feeling the connection with Dean Turner Art - jump on our website - take a good look at the 'Ultimate Reunion Series' (Best Sellers) - look at the reviews, and then head to our Facebook page to see what people are saying there.

If you know you're affiliate game well, you have great connections, ideas and experience and just want to get started, go for it!  Let us know how we can support you!

Finally, we can not take on every affiliate.  If you believe you can do well with us, please let us know your experience and why you feel you are a good fit with DTA.  That will help us work well together and keep the standard of business high for everyone!
payout_period: We'll aim to pay out affiliate partners on the first working day of every month.
